selection: Visually curated examples; all methods share prompt, seed and inference settings. Not a random sample or a measured win rate.

selection_criteria.expanded_g_apples_pears: Exactly two red apples and one green pear, distinct and fully framed. Base omits an apple; DiffusionNFT has one apple and two pears. Background rendering is not claimed superior.
selection_criteria.geneval_apples: Five distinguishable apples, versus fewer in the two alternatives. Original edge clipping is preserved.
selection_criteria.expanded_g_bottles: Three distinct red, green and blue bottles with polished reflections. Count and color are shared across methods; this is not a unique correctness win.
selection_criteria.expanded_g_teapot: Separate green teapot and red cup, with readable glaze and full objects. The color binding is also correct in the alternatives.
selection_criteria.expanded_g_ducks: Three complete yellow porcelain ducks versus two in Base. DiffusionNFT also achieves the requested count.
selection_criteria.expanded_g_boats: Both red and blue boats are fully in frame and separated. DiffusionNFT crops the red hull at the left; Base is also coherent.
selection_criteria.geneval_horse_car: Both colored subjects are fully included, unlike substantial cropping in the alternatives. Color correctness is shared, not unique.
selection_criteria.expanded_g_redmoon: Red moon, blue mountain and lake reflection form a readable panoramic scene. Shared prompt compliance; differences in color treatment are subjective.
selection_criteria.expanded_g_cup_book: Yellow cup on a closed blue book beside a red rose and clear vase. Book meets the left frame edge; no claim of universally better framing or complete background fidelity.
selection_criteria.geneval_cat_above: Both correctly colored bodies are shown and separated. The lower paw meets the frame edge; do not claim literally no clipping.
selection_criteria.ocr_cinema: RiDEx clearly spells MIDNIGHT CINEMA on the marquee; the alternatives distort MIDNIGHT. Base preserves richer architecture; no architectural-detail superiority claim.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_good: GOOD THINGS GROW is legible with supporting orchids and greenhouse framing. Exact wording is shared; Base preserves richer foliage.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_bluehour: THE BLUE HOUR is legible on a twilight storefront sign. DiffusionNFT also renders the wording; no unique text win claimed.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_paper: PAPER AND INK is clearly placed on a bookstore sign with books visible. Compared with Base's ampersand and NFT's extra dot, the requested literal wording is cleaner; scene detail is simplified.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_north: NORTH STAR is clearly printed on a plausible perfume bottle without extra label words. Base also renders the main wording accurately.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_sunday: SUNDAY STUDIO is exact and readable above ceramic pieces. Shared wording accuracy; simplified studio rendering is retained.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_dream: DREAM IN COLOR is clear on a framed print. Other methods also render the words; this is not evidence of a unique OCR gain.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_small: SMALL WONDERS is legible above mushroom and fern artwork without stray subtitle text. The botanical rendering is simpler than Base's.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_wild: WILD HORIZONS is correctly printed above a coherent mountain-lake poster. Wording is shared; the restrained illustration is not claimed more detailed.
selection_criteria.expanded_o_open: OPEN ALL NIGHT is exact on an illuminated sign with red seating below. Simplified night display, not a claim of better diner-scene fidelity than Base.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_market: Readable river, bridge and lantern composition. A subjective framing selection, not a measured preference win.
selection_criteria.hps_skycastle: Panoramic framing of castle, island, bridge and waterfall; not a measured preference win.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_botanical: Legible conservatory architecture, ferns and orchids. Both tuned outputs have oversized foreground flowers; no botanical-scale superiority claim.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_desert: Crisp tiered architecture and reflective pool in a balanced fantasy composition. Observatory-specific detail is not uniquely better.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_geisha: Detailed silk embroidery, readable face and two plausible hands at native resolution. Stylized portrait, not evidence of cultural or photographic accuracy.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_dragon: Readable fantasy creature and lantern with fine decorative detail. Not an anatomy claim or a claim that the creature literally wraps around the lantern.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_snowvillage: Full panoramic village and stream scene with distinct architectural forms. A subjective compositional choice; DiffusionNFT is also coherent.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_tea: Complete pavilion, wet path and readable warm interior, with balanced framing. No measured aesthetic win asserted.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_bookshop: Complete tree-building, entrance and readable book displays. Chosen for scene legibility, not universally greater detail.
selection_criteria.expanded_h_lotus: Clear translucent-looking petals and green base with a contained flower silhouette. Exact jade material fidelity is not established.
selection_criteria.expanded_p_palace: Coherent palace facade, arches and reflection across a panoramic fantasy composition. Subjective presentation choice, not an objective preference ranking.
selection_criteria.pick_clockwork: The complete mechanical subject and flower are contained in the frame, unlike the cut-off tails in the alternatives. Fantasy illustration, not anatomy evidence.
selection_criteria.expanded_p_orrery: Rich glass and brass detail with a fully shown pedestal. Some planets float without visible support; acceptable as imaginative artwork, not a mechanically correct instrument.
selection_criteria.expanded_p_patisserie: Coherent pastry display and readable stands with fine surface detail. Repeated tart forms and simplified street context remain; no universal quality win.

selection_criteria.expanded_p_courtyard: Coherent fountain, arches, roses and door framing with readable surfaces. Subjective material and composition comparison.
